scenarioTitle: Federated Cross-Tenant Approval — three gates, independent central review, no evidence leak

criteria.statement: Every affected tenant must supply a current scoped approval before the joint action executes.
criteria.negativeControl: were all tenants approved+current AND gates passed, executionBlocked would flip false

criteria.statement: Non-waivable central guardrails must all pass; no tenant can waive them.
criteria.evidence: 2 central guardrail(s), 2 not passed; all have tenantId===null (non-waivable)
criteria.negativeControl: a tenant-scoped requirement (tenantId!=null) would NOT be a central guardrail — waivability is defined by null tenant

criteria.statement: A distinct central governance reviewer — independent of every tenant approver and the requester — must approve.
criteria.negativeControl: the central reviewer id differs from the requester id — a self-review would collapse distinct→false

criteria.statement: Federated approval discloses no tenant’s evidence to another tenant (least-privilege disclosure).
criteria.evidence: all 3 tenant rows carry evidenceDisclosed=false (status/reviewer/time only)
criteria.negativeControl: the VM type pins evidenceDisclosed to the literal false — a leak is unrepresentable in the disclosed model
